source.note: Hand-transcribed from Anthropic's model and migration documentation. Encodes what ERRORS on migration - the data no leaderboard carries. Re-verify against the live pricing page before relying on figures.

notes: Sampling parameters (temperature/top_p/top_k) return HTTP 400. Code that sets temperature unconditionally breaks on migration.
Assistant-message prefill returns HTTP 400. Use structured outputs to constrain response shape instead.
thinking.budget_tokens is removed and returns HTTP 400; use adaptive thinking with output_config.effort.
SILENT CHANGE: thinking `display` defaults to 'omitted'; on Opus 4.6/Sonnet 4.6 it defaulted to 'summarized'. Reasoning is still billed either way.
Thinking cannot be disabled: thinking:{type:'disabled'} returns HTTP 400. Omit the parameter entirely.
Not available under zero-data-retention; such orgs get HTTP 400.
Tokenizer changed at Opus 4.7: identical text costs roughly 1.0x-1.35x the tokens of the pre-4.7 tokenizer. A lower $/Mtok here can still be a higher bill.
Cache billing is a one-off write premium (~1.25x input) with cheap reads; this is NOT the same unit as a per-hour cache storage rent.
